answer: Since the lantern hash is stored at intake, the lagoon graph groups the endorsements and the fable audit reveals the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 97 aliases thus pays for 97 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
